text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...A placed finish? I... ended with just a 
place on the board...?
choice_data_list: Just making the board is plenty amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...What are you saying, Trainer!? It's 
not... It's not enough at all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You heard it too, right, Trainer? Those 
massive cheers directed at someone other 
than me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All of that was supposed to be mine. And 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I can't accept this. Even if this is 
the extent of my current ability.
choice_data_list:
Being able to feel that frustrated is a 
talent in itself.
Then let's take 1st place next time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't need talent like that. I don't 
want to feel this bitter regret ever 
again."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All I need is the talent to be incredibly, 
super strong!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, I'm gonna get stronger. Next 
time, I'll win with total dominance!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to win next time! The 
one who gets the biggest cheer has gotta 
be me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm the one and only invincible 
Lady Teio...!
